full_prompt_en: A square cinematic anime illustration shows a blue commuter train beside a lonely coastal platform under towering sunlit clouds. A narrow pale border encloses the scene. The sky fills more than half the image, shifting from saturated azure to soft violet-blue near the horizon. An immense bank of cumulus cloud rises near the upper right, its upper faces cream-white and peach, its lower recesses blue and lavender. Thin power wires and metal supports cross the sky diagonally from the upper left toward the right-side poles. In the left middle, a teal-blue train stands on the track, its rounded front and repeating windows catching strips of warm light. A pantograph rests on its roof beneath the wires. The rails begin at the lower left and converge toward the distant center, their dark geometry drawing the eye past the train. At the right middle, one slender person stands alone on the platform facing away toward the bright coast, holding a dark bag. A row of poles and a railing run along the platform's right edge; beyond them, a thin bright band suggests open water. In the foreground, rough track structures and a deep dark recess create a strong blue-gray base under the glowing sky. Late-day sunlight comes from the right near the horizon, warming the cloud edges, train windows, and platform rim while the foreground remains cool and shaded. The image combines carefully drawn rails and wires with broad, expressive painted cloud strokes. Fine atmospheric haze softens the far structures without losing the crisp solitary silhouette. The overall composition feels expansive and wistful, balancing an anchored vehicle and tiny traveler beneath a sky of overwhelming color and light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带电影感的动画插图呈现一辆蓝色通勤列车，停在孤独的海边站台旁，头顶耸立着受光云层。一圈窄浅色边框围住场景。天空占画面大半，从饱和蔚蓝渐变到地平线附近柔和紫蓝色。一大片积云在右上方升起，上表面奶油白与桃色发亮，下方凹处呈蓝色和薰衣草紫。细电线与金属支架从左上方向右侧电杆斜穿天空。左侧中部，一辆青蓝色列车立在轨道上，圆润车头和重复窗户接住条状暖光。车顶集电弓处于电线下面。铁轨从左下开始，向远处中央汇合，深色几何线条把视线引过列车。右侧中部，一名细长人物独自站在站台，背向观者看着明亮海岸，手持深色袋子。一排电杆和栏杆沿站台右缘延伸；其外，一条细亮带暗示开阔水面。前景，粗糙轨道构件和深暗凹处在发光天空下构成强烈蓝灰色基底。晚间日光从右侧地平线附近照来，把云边、车窗与站台边缘染暖，前景仍冷而阴暗。图像把仔细勾画的轨道与电线同宽阔、富有表现力的云层笔触结合。细微空气薄雾柔化远处结构，却没有抹去孤独剪影的清楚边缘。整体构图开阔而怅然，以停住的车辆和细小旅人平衡色光压倒性的天空。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic animation image sets meticulously drawn linear infrastructure against vast painterly atmosphere. Saturated cerulean and teal dominate the cool field, while cream, peach, and lavender light breaks through in broad luminous masses. Fine wires, poles, and converging diagonals supply precise perspective; rougher brush strokes and soft haze shape the open upper area. Strong late side light warms selected rims and windows while the near base stays in deep blue shadow. A small solitary silhouette provides scale but does not compete with the weather-filled space. The overall effect is wistful, spacious, and luminous, with a disciplined contrast between sharp lines and swelling cloud color.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅电影感动画图像把精细绘出的线性构件放在广阔绘画式空气之前。饱和蔚蓝与青蓝主导冷色场，奶油色、桃色和薰衣草紫的光以宽大明亮体块穿出。细电线、竖杆和汇聚斜线提供精确透视；较粗的笔触与柔和薄雾塑造开阔的上部区域。强烈傍晚侧光使选定边缘和反光面变暖，近处基底保持深蓝影。小型孤独剪影提供尺度，却不与充满天气变化的空间争夺注意。整体效果怅然、宽阔而发亮，锐利线条与翻涌云色之间的受控对照是主要特征。
theme_en: A blue train and lone figure beneath luminous clouds at a coastal platform
theme_zh: 海边站台上蓝色列车与独行者，头顶云层发亮
name: Makoto Shinkai
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
